name: Boop never makes the wrong face
case: Over a mixed stretch of work (tests failing, then passing after failing, a long turn finishing well, then a new turn failing on an error), Boop's faces always fit what just happened. A failure never gets a happy, excited, proud, calm, focused, pleased, amused, mischievous or affectionate face, or a success. A win never gets an annoyed, grumpy, angry, wounded or sad face, or a failure.
why: Each face's meaning (annoyed, determined, grumpy and angry for failures, sad and wounded only for a big one; happy, excited, proud, calm and focused for wins, and pleased, amused, mischievous and affectionate never for a failure), and react.move's: a success only for a turn done, a failure for one that failed
